Every night afterward, he found himself glancing at the sea, wondering whose home it was, and whether they ever reached it.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按下了静音键。路灯把空荡荡的街道染成一片昏黄，偶尔有夜班出租车缓缓驶过，车灯划开薄雾。便利店还亮着灯，店员靠在柜台上打盹，货架上的面包安静地等待第一个顾客。远处高楼的轮廓模糊成影子，只有少数几扇窗还亮着，像是谁也没睡的秘密。清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面的声音格外清晰。风很凉，带着一点潮气，仿佛整座城市都在屏息，等待天边第一道光把它重新唤醒。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by asking a smaller copy of itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It keeps doing that, making the problem smaller each time, until it reaches a tiny version it can answer right away, called the base case.\n- Then all the small answers combine, step by step, to build the answer to the original big problem."}
